ryoamiclights.menu.canvas.1.en: Disabling entities dynamic lighting is recommended with Canvas!
ryoamiclights.menu.canvas.1.zh: 建议在使用Canvas时禁用实体动态光照！

ryoamiclights.menu.canvas.2.en: Dynamic lighting with Canvas is currently performance heavy!
ryoamiclights.menu.canvas.2.zh: 目前动态光照与Canvas同时使用会非常地吃性能！

ryoamiclights.tooltip.block_entities.zh: 启用方块实体的动态光照。

ryoamiclights.tooltip.creeper_lighting.en:
Sets the Creeper dynamic lighting mode.
- %s disables Creeper dynamic lighting.
- %s sets a constant luminance.
- %s sets a dynamic luminance.
ryoamiclights.tooltip.creeper_lighting.zh:
设置苦力怕的动态光照模式。
- %s 禁用苦力怕动态光照。
- %s 会设置一个恒定的亮度。
- %s 会设置动态的亮度。

ryoamiclights.tooltip.entities.en: Enables entities dynamic lighting. Note: players are always active.
ryoamiclights.tooltip.entities.zh: 启用实体动态光照。注：与玩家的设置相独立。

ryoamiclights.tooltip.mode.1.en: Enables dynamic lights. If enabled a player holding a torch will light up the area for example.
ryoamiclights.tooltip.mode.1.zh: 启用动态光照。若启用，手持光源的玩家将照亮其附近。

ryoamiclights.tooltip.mode.2.en: %s and %s will lag a bit behind but minimizes light updates.
ryoamiclights.tooltip.mode.2.zh: %s 和 %s 会略有延迟，以减少光照更新。

ryoamiclights.tooltip.self_light_source.en: Enables first-person dynamic lighting. It's recommended to disable this if you're using shaders that has their own dynamic lighting.
ryoamiclights.tooltip.self_light_source.zh: 启用第一人称动态光照。如果你使用自带动态光照的着色器，建议禁用该功能。

ryoamiclights.tooltip.tnt_lighting.en:
Sets the TNT dynamic lighting mode.
- %s disables TNT dynamic lighting.
- %s sets a constant luminance.
- %s sets a dynamic luminance.
ryoamiclights.tooltip.tnt_lighting.zh:
设置TNT的动态光照模式。
- %s 禁用TNT动态光照。
- %s 会设置一个恒定的亮度。
- %s 会设置动态的亮度。

ryoamiclights.tooltip.water_sensitive.en: Enables the water-sensitive light sources check. This means that some items will not emit light while being submerged in water.
ryoamiclights.tooltip.water_sensitive.zh: 启用水敏光源检查。这意味着某些物品被浸没在水中时将不会发光。
